packages.title: Everest Base Camp & Kala Patthar High Trek
safetyGuidelines: Mandatory rest/acclimatization days in Namche & Dingboche

itinerary.title: Fly Kathmandu to Lukla (2,840m) & Trek to Phakding
itinerary.desc: Scenic flight into Tenzing-Hillary Airport, followed by gradual riverside trek along the Dudh Koshi.

itinerary.title: Phakding to Namche Bazaar
itinerary.desc: Cross Hillary Suspension Bridge and make the steep ascent to the capital of the Khumbu.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Day in Namche Bazaar
itinerary.desc: Hike to Everest View Hotel for first panorama of Ama Dablam, Lhotse, and Everest.

itinerary.title: Namche to Tengboche Monastery
itinerary.desc: Forested descent followed by ascent to the spiritual heart of the Khumbu.

itinerary.title: Tengboche to Dingboche
itinerary.desc: Trek above tree line into the high alpine valley with close views of Ama Dablam.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization in Dingboche
itinerary.desc: Ascend Nagarjun Hill for sweeping views of Makalu and Island Peak.

itinerary.title: Dingboche to Lobuche
itinerary.desc: Pass the memorials for fallen mountaineers at Thokla Pass.

itinerary.title: Lobuche to Gorak Shep & Everest Base Camp
itinerary.desc: Walk alongside Khumbu Glacier to reach EBC, return to Gorak Shep for the night.

itinerary.title: Kala Patthar Summit & Descend to Pheriche
itinerary.desc: Pre-dawn climb for iconic sunrise over Mount Everest crest.

itinerary.title: Pheriche to Namche Bazaar
itinerary.desc: Long steady descent back to high-altitude comforts.

itinerary.title: Namche to Lukla
itinerary.desc: Final trekking day celebrating with the crew.

itinerary.title: Fly Lukla to Kathmandu
itinerary.desc: Morning flight back to capital and hotel transfer.

exclusions: Hot showers/charging fees at high altitude

itinerary.title: Drive Kathmandu to Besisahar & Chame
itinerary.desc: Scenic mountain highway transition.

itinerary.title: Chame to Pisang
itinerary.desc: Walk through pine forests facing Paungda Danda rock wall.

itinerary.title: Upper Pisang to Manang
itinerary.desc: Spectacular vistas of Annapurna II, III, and IV.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Day in Manang
itinerary.desc: Visit Gangapurna Lake and Milarepa Cave.

itinerary.title: Manang to Yak Kharka
itinerary.desc: Steady climb into alpine tundra.

itinerary.title: Yak Kharka to Thorong Phedi
itinerary.desc: Base of the massive pass.

itinerary.title: Cross Thorong La Pass (5,416m) to Muktinath
itinerary.desc: Epic dawn traverse into Mustang arid plains.

itinerary.title: Muktinath to Jomsom via Kagbeni
itinerary.desc: Walk through Kali Gandaki river canyon.

itinerary.title: Fly or Drive Jomsom to Pokhara
itinerary.desc: Relax by Phewa Lake.

conversations.lastMessage: All acclimatization gear and microspikes are packed. See you in Lukla on April 1st!
Your TIMS and Sagarmatha National Park entry permits have been issued by the NTB officer.

messages.content: Namaste Pasang Dai! Should we bring our own thermal sleeping bags or do the tea houses supply down blankets?
Namaste Aayush bhai! Tea houses have quilts, but above Namche at Lobuche and Gorak Shep it drops to -15C. I strongly recommend bringing a -20C down bag. We will do a full gear check in Kathmandu.
All acclimatization gear and microspikes are packed. See you in Lukla on April 1st!

communityPosts.content: Watching the morning alpenglow illuminate the granite pyramids of Ama Dablam at 4,600m. The sheer serenity of early autumn in the high Himalaya is unmatched.

comments.text: Great photo! The ridge route is crystal clear this morning.

communityPosts.content: Safety Advisory: The northern descent from Cho La Pass has fresh compacted hard-ice. Microspikes or crampons are required for all crossing parties. Stay roped up on the glacial slope.

comments.text: Thank you Pasang Dai, briefing our teams immediately.

communityPosts.content: Khumbu Icefall route for the upcoming summit window is fully secured by our Icefall Doctors team. Aluminum ladders installed across the western cwm crevasses. Team spirit is sky high!

comments.text: Helicopter supply drops at Camp 2 completed smoothly today. Fly safe, brothers!

communityPosts.content: Dusk falls over the Golden Temple (Hiranya Varna Mahavihar). Hundreds of bronze oil lamps flickering in the autumn breeze. This living craftsmanship has survived over eight centuries.

comments.text: The architecture of Patan is without a doubt one of the world gems.

communityPosts.content: We reached the signpost at 5,416m at 06:45 AM! Freezing winds, prayer flags whipping fiercely, and the first rays hitting Dhaulagiri. Hardest trek of my life and the greatest reward.

comments.text: Massive congratulations Liam! Enjoy the downhill walk to Muktinath.

communityPosts.content: Silent canoe drift at dawn. Out of the morning mist emerged an Asian One-horned Rhinoceros grazing gently along the riverbank while kingfishers plunged into the water. True paradise!

comments.text: Glad you loved the morning drift Priya! Mother rhino was very relaxed.

communityPosts.content: Mani Rimdu festival mask dance rehearsals in full swing at the monastery courtyard. The sound of long copper horns reverberating across the Khumbu valley brings goosebumps every single time.
No roads, no engines, zero pollution. Just pure turquoise water so transparent you can see underwater rock ledges tens of meters deep under towering snow peaks. Dolpo is the final frontier.
Standing on Kala Patthar watching the first golden ray hit the summit pyramid of Everest (8,848.86m), Nuptse, and the Changtse wall in Tibet. Never gets old even after 16 years of guiding.
